caption: The drawing shows a wooden box with two doors open outward, revealing multiple glass bottles inside. The box is dark brown with a visible wood grain pattern and metal hinges and handle that are golden in color. On the top of the box is a flat rectangular golden handle with decorative detailing. The interior consists of shelves in three sections: left door, central body, and right door. Each section contains several bottles of varying shapes and sizes. The bottles are mostly transparent, although some appear bluish, greenish, or opaque white. The left and right doors each contain shelves with three bottles; two on the upper shelf and one on the lower shelf. The central section contains a top shelf holding four bottles, mostly larger and colored in shades of green, blue, and clear white. Below the shelf, there is a wooden panel with a round knob in the center, suggesting a compartment or drawer. The bottles have round or square shoulders, and some have stoppers or lids. The whole arrangement is illustrated against a plain, light beige background.
title: Medicine Chest
